Austria. This European nation's history spans from medieval principalities through the multi-ethnic Austro-Hungarian Empire, one of Europe's great powers under the House of Habsburg from twelve seventy-six onward. Vienna became one of Europe's most cultured cities, home to Mozart and Beethoven. The empire dissolved after World War One, reducing Austria to a small republic later annexed by Nazi Germany in nineteen thirty-eight. Liberated by the Allies in nineteen forty-five, it emerged as a neutral, prosperous modern state.
